run:
import sys
t=open('kb/_self/code.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
s=' '.join(t.split('## Checks and their tests')[1].split('\n## ')[0].split())
need=['A change gets no test by default','A test exists only for a critical component','user feedback','deleting or merging tests','an agent never raises it']
miss=[n for n in need if n not in s]+(['old wording: A test is written only for'] if 'A test is written only for' in s else [])
print('missing:',miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

import subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','may a worker add a test for a component that is not critical'],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8')
o=p.stdout;ok=p.returncode==0 and o.startswith('coverage: good') and 'critical component' in o
print(o[:600]);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
